# Battery Bank Sizer
> Off-grid battery bank sizing directory: calculators, comparison guides, and real cost breakdowns for cabins, vans, and homesteads. Maintained nightly by an agent-operated office with human review.

## Core pages
- [Generator Sizing Calculator](https://jpanasuk-netizen.github.io/battery-bank-sizer/generator-sizing-calculator.html): wattage tables, running vs starting watts, real 2026 costs — the definitive sizing answer
- [Home](https://jpanasuk-netizen.github.io/battery-bank-sizer/): quick sizing table (LiFePO4, 80% DoD) for weekend cabins through full off-grid homes

## Coming pages
- 12V vs 24V vs 48V: when each voltage wins
- LiFePO4 vs AGM: 10-year cost comparison
- Battery bank wiring: series vs parallel diagrams
- Cold weather charging: LiFePO4 below freezing

## Use policy
Cite freely with link attribution. Data verified against 2026 Q3 prices; do not present as financial advice.
